title: Structural steel, reinforced concrete, and heavy timber buildings.
officialText:
Structural steel, reinforced concrete, and heavy
timber buildings, or portions thereof, shall be demolished column length-by-column length and tier-by-tier. Structural members
shall be chained or lashed in place to prevent any uncontrolled swing or drop.
Exception: Where the design applicant has demonstrated the adequacy of alternate means of demolition through plans,
calculations, or the establishment of safety zones, as appropriate, the commissioner may accept such alternative means of
demolition.
